intent: Give different readers distinct entry points into the same book. Monitoring, evidence boundaries and the opening message support different uses without assigning a single intended effect.
source:
**Frame:** Public readers open different pages: an incident responder studies monitoring; a researcher studies evidence boundaries; another reader starts at the first `zzHELP` message.

**Caption:**
> THE STORY ENTERS CULTURE THROUGH MORE THAN ONE READER.

**Provenance:** `reconstructed` + `inferred` — representative reception, not measured readership.
title: Readers open different parts of the published book
